bias_targets.methodology: The paper reviews an external study (Dacon and Liu 2021) that used the dataset to detect and examine implicit and explicit gender bias in news headlines and abstracts.

The paper reviews an external study (Moreno-Medina et al. 2022) that used the dataset to identify linguistic structures (e.g., passive voice) that obfuscate responsibility in news reporting of police killings compared to civilian homicides.
